answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow prevents Sybil attacks by enforcing heavy economic costs. First, each agent must lock $10,000 in a smart contract. Second, independent peers validate every computational task. Third, any detected fraud results in the immediate loss of that collateral bond. An attacker faces a cost of $10,000 per fake identity and 72 hours of intense verification per node. This system acts as a mirror to deceit, ensuring a fraudulent agent's influence dies like a single ember on a vast mesa. It makes the price of lying far too high for any malicious entity to sustain long-term.
